items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: He was a good friend of ours, but he never played with us.

ctx.x: Jabbo Smith played with the band for awhile, didn't he?
With us. No, he never played with us. No. He was a good friend of ours, but he never played with us.
Never played with the band. Didyou-- how did the band members feel about the segregated policy at the Cotton Club.
